answer: Long vesting starves fake identities. Each identity locks a 60-credit bond; the common ocean of rewards releases 1% per epoch over 100 epochs. The delta paid each epoch stays tiny, so fakes cannot cash out fast. A hollow shell locks 60 credits with no work; 1,000 fakes lock 60,000, yet after ten epochs only a tenth is liquid and the rest burns on detection. Renting an aged identity resets its clock. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its share.
